sources.title: Can Apple M3 Ultra run Qwen3.8 27B? Measured 12.46 tok/s
sources.snippet: Memory: Apple M3 Ultra has 512 GB. Qwen3.8 27B weights are about 16.5 GB at Q4_K_M (27B params × 4.89 bits ÷ 8, before context/KV cache). Arithmetic, not a measurement; long contexts need more. Check other quants in the VRAM calculator.

sources.title: Can I run Qwen3.8 27B on Apple M3 Ultra (80-core GPU)? - llmap.ai
sources.snippet: Yes. Qwen3.8 27B runs on Apple M3 Ultra (80-core GPU) (512 GB) at Q4_K_M — estimated 34 tok/s with 262K usable context.
